description: Defines classes and interfaces related to proof verification for QUIC in Chromium, including ProofVerifierChromium and associated details.

classes.name: ProofVerifyDetailsChromium
classes.description: Implementation-specific proof verification details including certificate verification result, pinning failure log, and flags for PKP bypass and fatal errors.

classes.name: ProofVerifyContextChromium
classes.description: Context information for proof verification, including verification flags and logging source.

classes.name: ProofVerifierChromium
classes.description: Implements QUIC proof verification interface, capable of handling multiple requests, verifying proofs and certificate chains.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates a copy of the proof verify details.

methods.name: ProofVerifierChromium(...)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the verifier with dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: VerifyProof(...)
methods.description: Verifies a proof for a given hostname and parameters.

methods.name: VerifyCertChain(...)
methods.description: Verifies a certificate chain for a hostname.

methods.name: CreateDefaultContext()
methods.description: Creates a default proof verify context.

methods.name: OnJobComplete(Job*)
methods.description: Handles completion of a verification job.
